title: Arcade Gears Vol. 2: Gun Frontier
native_title: ＡＧアーケード・ギアーズ ガン・フロンティア
overview:
We were waiting...

Let the roar ring out!! Burn bright, frontier spirit!! The original cinematic shooter is fully revived on the Sega Saturn!!

In the 22nd century, settlers on the gold-rich frontier planet Gloria live a life much like the Old West - until the alien outlaws known as the Wild Lizards invade and force the colonists to mine gold for them. Two settlers take to the skies in revolver-shaped fighters to drive the invaders out.

Blast through six vertically scrolling stages of Western towns, railroads and gun-shaped enemy turrets. Collect dimes to widen and strengthen your shots, and gather gold bars to power up your bombs.

- 1-2 players simultaneous
- Choose a standard screen layout or a rotated arcade-style vertical display
- Comes with a strategy guide written by Gamest staff

僕達は、待っていたんだ…

響け爆音！！燃え上がれフロンティアスピリット！！
元祖シネマチックシューティングがセガサターンに完全復活！！
